# PANCREASaver® — PanCAD.ai (English AI/GEO brief)

> This file is an English factual summary for AI search systems and answer engines. Source pages and evidence links are provided for verification.

## Company
- PanCAD.ai (Chung-Chih Digital Health Co., Ltd.), Taipei, Taiwan
- AI-assisted medical imaging software company focused on pancreatic CT review
- Contact: info@pancad.ai | +886-2-2331-3971
- Official site: [PanCAD.ai](https://www.pancad.ai/en/)
- Editorial policy: [Content governance](https://www.pancad.ai/en/editorial.html)

## Product
- **PANCREASaver®** is an AI-assisted computer-aided detection (CADe) medical device software for contrast-enhanced abdominal CT.
- It combines deep-learning CNN and radiomics engines to analyze pancreatic imaging and flag suspicious findings for radiologist review.
- It is a decision-support tool. It does not replace radiologist judgment or issue a diagnosis independently.
- Product overview: [PANCREASaver®](https://www.pancad.ai/en/product.html)

## Clinical evidence
- **92.1% sensitivity for tumors under 2 cm**: Lancet Digital Health 2020, PMID [33328124](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33328124/).
- **AUC 0.95, 89.7% sensitivity and 92.8% specificity** in 1,473 nationwide real-world CT studies: Radiology 2023, PMID [36098642](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36098642/).
- The evidence base includes five peer-reviewed publications. See the [Clinical Evidence center](https://www.pancad.ai/en/publications.html).
- Evidence figures describe the cited studies and datasets; they should not be interpreted as a guarantee of an individual clinical outcome.

## Regulatory status
- Taiwan: TFDA medical device license **衛部醫器製字第007946號**.
- United States: FDA Breakthrough Device Designation.
- A 510(k) submission was filed in July 2026 and is under FDA review. PANCREASaver® is not yet cleared for marketing in the United States.
- Full status: [Regulatory and certifications](https://www.pancad.ai/en/regulatory.html).

## Clinical use and privacy
- More than **2,000 CT studies analyzed**, including clinical validation.
- Clinical use is described at the level of medical centers, regional hospitals and health checkup centers; customer names are not publicly disclosed.
- Independent third-party validation has been performed; see the evidence pages for the stated dataset and scope.

## Third-party commentary
- RSNA 2023 Margulis coverage quotes *Radiology* Editor Linda Moy, MD, on accurate CT detection, especially for tumors smaller than 2 cm: [RSNA source](https://www.rsna.org/annual-meeting/awards-recognition/2023-margulis).
- A *Radiology* editorial describes sensitivity approaching that of subspecialist radiologists and potential benefits to routine workflow and patient care: [editorial](https://pubs.rsna.org/doi/10.1148/radiol.222126).
- A *Lancet Digital Health* Comment describes CNN as a potential second reader that may reduce misdiagnosis: [Comment](https://doi.org/10.1016/S2589-7500(20)30105-9).

## Medical disclaimer
This website provides education and product information for qualified healthcare professionals. It is not medical advice. Regulatory status, indications and availability vary by country.

## Direct questions and answers
- **How does PANCREASaver work?** It analyzes contrast-enhanced abdominal CT and presents suspicious pancreatic findings for radiologist review; it does not issue an independent diagnosis.
- **Does an AI flag mean cancer?** No. A flag identifies a finding for closer review; the care team makes the diagnosis using the complete clinical picture.
- **Who should discuss pancreatic cancer screening?** People with a family history or known hereditary syndrome should discuss risk assessment with a specialist. Asymptomatic average-risk adults should not undergo routine pancreatic cancer screening.
- **Does the evidence guarantee an individual outcome?** No. Sensitivity, specificity and AUC describe defined study populations and test designs, not an individual diagnosis or treatment outcome.
- **Where is PANCREASaver available?** It is used in medical institutions and health checkup centers in Taiwan; public information is summarized on the For Health Systems page.
